target.frequency_policy: each row is the next actual weekday ECOS observation

direction_metric.name: origin_direction_accuracy
direction_metric.tie_policy: a tie is correct only when both directions are zero

scaled_metric.name: MASE
scaled_metric.scale: mean absolute one-step difference in the training segment available at each forecast origin
scaled_metric.data_leakage_rule: never calculate the scale with validation or future observations

baseline_comparison.required_baseline: Random Walk / last observation carried forward

deferred_metrics.CRPS: consider after the initial quantile backtest is stable
deferred_metrics.RMSSE: consider when comparing currencies with different price scales

finetuning_plan.split_policy: fixed chronological train, validation, and final test periods
finetuning_plan.full_finetuning: only if LoRA results and compute cost justify it
success_criteria: lower MAE and RMSE than Random Walk on the untouched final test period
lower MAE and RMSE than zero-shot Chronos-2 on the untouched final test period
improvement is not driven only by a few volatile forecast origins
better balance between 80% interval coverage and interval width
no repeated configuration selection using final test results
